items.distractor_fact: Kito termometro rodmuo tą pačią naktį buvo {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: Another thermometer's reading that same night was {D}°C. Bare digit followed by the invariant symbol °C, grammatical for any integer.
items.entity_note: Owner is an instrument (a different thermometer), whereas the first distractor's owner was a place (a neighboring town).

items.distractor_fact: Vieno prekiautojo sąskaitos likutis tą pačią dieną buvo {D}€.
items.gloss_en: One trader's account balance that same day was {D}€. Digit+€ construction, invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: Owner is a person (a trader), whereas the first distractor's owner was an organisation (another company).

items.entity_note: Owner is an instrument (a different gauge), whereas the first distractor's owner was a place (another pond).

items.gloss_en: One worker's personally produced unit count during the same month was {D} units. Fixed abbreviation 'vnt.' never inflects after a numeral.
items.entity_note: Owner is a person (an individual worker), whereas the first distractor's owner was an organisational unit (another workshop); the worker's own plan figure is not stated, so this cannot substitute for the workshop's plan-vs-actual pair (rule 6).

items.entity_note: Owner is an organisation (a weather service), whereas the first distractor's owner was a place/instrument (another station); that service's own forecast is not stated, so this cannot substitute for the story's forecast (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Praėjusio turnyro rezultatų suvestinėje kito ruožo vidutinis smūgių skaičius buvo {D}.
items.gloss_en: In last tournament's results summary, the average stroke count for a different hole was {D}. Bare-predicate pattern ('skaičius buvo {D}'), invariant for any integer.
items.entity_note: Owner is an event/organisation (a past tournament), whereas the first distractor's owner was a person (another player); it is also tied to a different hole, so this story's stated par does not apply to it (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Turnyro lentelėje nurodytas visų žaidėjų vidurkis buvo {D}.

items.entity_note: Owner is an organisation/event (the tournament as a whole), whereas the first distractor's owner was a single person (another player); an overall average across all players is not tied to this hole's stated par (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Kito vežėjo organizuojamo maršruto traukinio faktinis atvykimo laikas buvo {D} min nuo paros pradžios.

items.entity_note: Owner is an organisation (a carrier company), whereas the first distractor's owner was a different line/service; that carrier's own schedule is not stated, so this cannot substitute for the story's timetable value (rule 6).
